final: WITH pr AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS pid, p.fundflux AS ff, AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), fa AS (SELECT pid, ff, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY ff) AS favg FROM pr) SELECT pid AS project_id, ff AS funding_source, ratio, ratio - favg AS excess FROM fa ORDER BY (ratio - favg) IS NULL, (ratio - favg) DESC LIMIT 10
